alt: 家人忙著掃地整理，一名大人卻躺在沙發吃零食，揮手拒絕遞來的掃帚，身旁家事仍堆著未做。
scene_prompt: Modern family living room before cleanup. Healthy adult lounges comfortably on sofa with feet on ottoman. Exactly TWO arms: LEFT hand holds one small biscuit above snack bowl on lap; RIGHT hand lazily waves away broom offered by another adult. NO fan, no phone, no other hand-held object. Lounger awake cheerful and choosing comfort over fair share of housework. Unfinished laundry and trash basket beside sofa. Two family members actively sweep and carry bags outside doorway. Natural two arms per person, proper five fingers, supported sofa and ottoman, grounded feet, coherent contact and perspective. 3:2 landscape graphite pencil soft watercolor colored pencil ivory paper; no text brands logos letters numerals or watermarks.
